Broccoli Alternaria leaf spot.cause: Fungal pathogen Alternaria brassicae and Alternaria brassicicola thriving in humid, warm conditions (15–25°C).
Broccoli Alternaria leaf spot.symptoms: Concentric dark brown to black circular lesions with yellow halos on older leaves.
Broccoli Alternaria leaf spot.treatment: Prune and dispose of severely infected foliage. Apply certified copper-based or bio-fungicides (e.g., Bacillus subtilis) during early morning.
Broccoli Alternaria leaf spot.prevention: Avoid overhead watering; space plants for adequate airflow; practice 3-year crop rotation away from brassicas.

Broccoli Black rot.cause: Bacterium Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris spread via splashing water, infected seeds, and agricultural tools.
Broccoli Black rot.symptoms: Characteristic V-shaped yellow chlorotic lesions starting at leaf margins with blackened veins.
Broccoli Black rot.treatment: Immediately remove infected plants to prevent field spread; apply preventive copper hydroxide sprays to adjacent healthy crops.
Broccoli Black rot.prevention: Use certified disease-free hot-water-treated seeds, control brassica weeds, and implement strict drip irrigation.

Broccoli Healthy leaf.symptoms: Uniform deep green/blue-green coloration with smooth waxy texture and no spots or blemishes.
Broccoli Healthy leaf.treatment: No disease detected. Keep monitoring and water properly at the base.
Broccoli Healthy leaf.prevention: Maintain balanced nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium fertilization, consistent soil moisture, and periodic scouting.

Cabbage Black rot.cause: Xanthomonas campestris bacterial infection through hydathodes along the leaf edge.
Cabbage Black rot.symptoms: V-shaped yellow wedges extending from leaf borders inward; vascular leaf veins turn brown to black.
Cabbage Black rot.treatment: Rogue out infected heads; sanitize cultivation tools between rows; apply protective bactericides.
Cabbage Black rot.prevention: Rotate crops with non-cruciferous plants for at least 3 years; maintain raised planting beds to improve drainage.

Cabbage Grey mould.cause: Fungus Botrytis cinerea attacking stressed or wounded tissue in cool, damp, stagnant microclimates.
Cabbage Grey mould.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions covered in fuzzy greyish-brown spore carpets on outer leaves.
Cabbage Grey mould.treatment: Carefully remove and bag infected outer wrapper leaves; apply registered fungicides like fludioxonil or bio-protectants.
Cabbage Grey mould.prevention: Ensure high air circulation, avoid damaging leaves during weeding, and reduce greenhouse/tunnel humidity.

Cabbage Healthy leaf.cause: Optimal growth conditions with no detected pathogens.
Cabbage Healthy leaf.symptoms: Crisp, robust leaves with characteristic natural bloom and uniform hue.
Cabbage Healthy leaf.treatment: No disease detected. Keep monitoring and water properly without wetting head foliage.
Cabbage Healthy leaf.prevention: Continue regular pest scouting (cabbage moths, aphids) and mulch beds to preserve steady moisture.

Cabbage Leaf spots.cause: Cercospora brassicicola or Pseudocercosporella capsellae fungal infections.
Cabbage Leaf spots.symptoms: Small circular to oval pale tan spots with distinct dark borders across leaf blades.
Cabbage Leaf spots.treatment: Strip lower damaged leaves; apply organic neem extract or systemic fungicide according to label directions.
Cabbage Leaf spots.prevention: Destroy old crop debris immediately after harvest; do not work in wet fields.

Cabbage Tip burn.cause: Physiological calcium deficiency in rapidly expanding inner leaves caused by fluctuating water supply or rapid growth.
Cabbage Tip burn.symptoms: Browning and marginal necrosis (drying/curling) on inner leaf tips.
Cabbage Tip burn.treatment: Correct soil moisture fluctuations with automated drip lines; apply calcium nitrate foliar spray.
Cabbage Tip burn.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer that accelerates rapid leaf expansion; maintain soil pH between 6.0 and 6.8.

Cauliflower Alternaria leaf spot.cause: Alternaria species infecting foliage during periods of extended leaf wetness.
Cauliflower Alternaria leaf spot.symptoms: Concentric target-like rings with yellow chlorotic margins on wrapper and outer leaves.
Cauliflower Alternaria leaf spot.treatment: Apply targeted copper soap or biofungicides; eliminate severely spotted outer leaves.
Cauliflower Alternaria leaf spot.prevention: Utilize wide row spacing to accelerate dew drying; avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.

Cauliflower Bacterial soft rot.cause: Pectobacterium carotovorum (formerly Erwinia) entering through insect wounds or handling cracks.
Cauliflower Bacterial soft rot.symptoms: Rapidly expanding mushy, slimy water-soaked lesions with a distinct foul odor.
Cauliflower Bacterial soft rot.treatment: Immediately destroy infected plants; do not compost. Disinfect all tools and hands.
Cauliflower Bacterial soft rot.prevention: Control chewing insect pests (flea beetles, caterpillars) that create entry wounds; ensure sharp field drainage.

Cauliflower Black rot.cause: Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris bacterial pathogen.
Cauliflower Black rot.symptoms: Marginal V-shaped yellowing accompanied by dark blackened vein networks.
Cauliflower Black rot.treatment: Remove symptomatic plants; apply protective copper spray barriers to adjacent plants.
Cauliflower Black rot.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars, use certified pathogen-free transplants, and rotate brassicas out of the field for 3 years.

Cauliflower Healthy leaf.cause: Strong plant immunity and healthy growing environment.
Cauliflower Healthy leaf.symptoms: Upright, broad, intact green leaves providing natural shade to the developing curd.
Cauliflower Healthy leaf.treatment: No disease detected. Keep monitoring and water properly at the base.
Cauliflower Healthy leaf.prevention: Maintain soil micronutrient balance (especially boron and molybdenum) and keep consistent moisture.

Cauliflower Yellow virus.cause: Turnip Yellow Mosaic Virus (TYMV) or Cauliflower Mosaic Virus (CaMV) transmitted primarily by aphids and flea beetles.
Cauliflower Yellow virus.symptoms: Bright yellow mosaic mottling, vein clearing, leaf distortion, and stunted growth.
Cauliflower Yellow virus.treatment: Viral infections cannot be cured; remove and destroy infected plants to stop vector spread.
Cauliflower Yellow virus.prevention: Manage aphid vectors using reflective mulches and insecticidal soaps; eliminate wild cruciferous weed hosts.

Turnip Alternaria leaf spot.cause: Alternaria brassicae fungal spores spread through wind and rain splash.
Turnip Alternaria leaf spot.symptoms: Small brown/black circular lesions expanding with concentric rings on turnip tops.
Turnip Alternaria leaf spot.treatment: Apply potassium bicarbonate or copper-based sprays; harvest healthy root crops promptly.
Turnip Alternaria leaf spot.prevention: Clear all brassica plant debris after harvest; practice multi-year crop rotation.

Turnip Black rot.cause: Bacterial pathogen Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris.
Turnip Black rot.symptoms: V-shaped yellow patches at leaf tips and darkening of leaf veins.
Turnip Black rot.treatment: Isolate affected section, prune outer affected leaves, and apply copper bactericide to healthy neighbors.
Turnip Black rot.prevention: Ensure hot-water treated seed usage, control brassica weed species, and avoid working when dew is present.

Turnip Healthy leaf.cause: Vibrant and balanced growth without physiological or biological stress.
Turnip Healthy leaf.symptoms: Bright lush green serrated foliage free of discolorations or necrotic spots.
Turnip Healthy leaf.treatment: No disease detected. Keep monitoring and water properly to support root bulb expansion.
Turnip Healthy leaf.prevention: Ensure loose, well-draining soil and regular weeding to avoid root competition.

Turnip Leaf spots.cause: Cercospora or Colletotrichum fungal spores under high humidity.
Turnip Leaf spots.symptoms: Scattered circular spots with pale centers and dark borders across turnip greens.
Turnip Leaf spots.treatment: Trim badly infected greens; apply approved organic sulfur or copper spray.
Turnip Leaf spots.prevention: Thin turnip seedlings properly for adequate airflow and utilize drip irrigation.
